entry: HandoverControls, HandoverOwner and the shared authenticated handover client
checks: The real owner binds paged rows and choices to the selected child, scope, document/snapshot and avatar versions.
The shared component shows reason, inclusion and dates; the user can include an entire crossing document and deselect an in-range one.
Date changes and identity changes clear the old choices and discard late responses.
An item with only permitted metadata can be omitted and then restored to its default without requesting an unreadable original.
The existing Hong Kong inclusive-day form and the recipient date display use the shared contracts.
environment: Local Node 24, shared component/owner, synthetic transport
